summary: Independent read-only review of the refrozen C5 design. Direct additionalProperties and parent-level oneOf diagnostics are explicitly accepted for their respective objects while neither echoes unknown sensitive keys or values. The acceptance tests cover root, ordinary nested, all three discriminated objects and legacy diagnostic compatibility. REV-0004 RF-001 is resolved. The new spec hash matches this context; classification remains REVIEW/V1. Two direct-diagnostic tests remain expected RED pending a new owner spec approval and implementation. This design conclusion is not owner approval, verification or Gate.
